name: La Boîte Artisanale — Email Order Processing

filters.q: subject:(order OR ordering OR "would like to order") is:unread

parameters.subject: Your order — missing shipping address
parameters.message:
=Hello {{ $json.customer_name || 'there' }},

Thank you for your order for {{ $json.product || 'your product' }}.

Could you please send us your full shipping address so we can prepare the dispatch?

Thank you,

Marc
La Boîte Artisanale

parameters.subject: =[ALERT] Out of stock — order from {{ $('Extract Order Fields').item.json.customer_name || $('Extract Order Fields').item.json.customer_email }}
=Your order {{ $json.order_number }} is confirmed — La Boîte Artisanale

before_activating: 1. Replace REPLACE_WITH_CREDENTIAL_ID with the real Gmail OAuth2 credential ID
2. Replace REPLACE_WITH_CREDENTIAL_ID with the real Google Sheets OAuth2 credential ID
3. Replace REPLACE_WITH_GOOGLE_SHEET_ID with the ID of Marc's 'Orders & Stock' Google Sheet
4. Verify the 'Stock' tab has a 'Product' column and a 'Stock_available' column
5. Verify the 'Orders' tab has columns: Date, Number, Customer Name, Email, Product, Quantity, Address, Status, Source
6. Test on 5 real order emails in 'Test workflow' mode before activating
7. Set active: true once tests pass
credentials_to_create: Gmail OAuth2: Marc's Gmail account (marc@laboiteartisanale.fr) — scopes: gmail.readonly + gmail.send
Google Sheets OAuth2: same Google account — scope: spreadsheets
